summary: The exact archive and deterministic-build identity verify, legacy request 38/62 compatibility remains intact, and immutable baselines are preserved. F2 is rejected because committed code still permits an unbounded synchronous request-70 response write on Unity's main thread, uses absolute level time as the per-shot timeout, has residual verifier and persistence confinement gaps, can emit invalid JSON for control characters, and does not failure-atomically replace the packaged archive.

blocking_findings.description: Request 70 can construct a response approaching the 64 MiB envelope cap and synchronously write it through NetworkStream.Write from the Unity coroutine without a send timeout. A client can send request byte 70 and stop reading, fill the socket buffer, and block the Unity frame loop indefinitely.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Move response transmission off the Unity main thread or implement deadline-governed nonblocking/chunked writes, then add a non-reading-client regression test.

blocking_findings.description: The recorder compares global Time.fixedTime directly with TimeoutSeconds instead of elapsed time since shot start. Shots beginning after 120 seconds can fail immediately and earlier shots receive inconsistent budgets.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Store the shot start fixed time, compare elapsed time, and test a shot that starts well after the configured timeout value.

blocking_findings.description: The verifier joins the archive filename from archive.sha256 and payload paths from provenance.json without enforcing one confined relative path. Tar validation rejects traversal and links but accepts special members such as FIFOs or devices.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require single non-absolute confined relative paths for receipt and provenance entries, permit regular files/directories only, and add traversal plus special-member tests.

blocking_findings.description: Archive verification has no compressed-size, member-count, per-member-size, total-expanded-size, duplicate-name, or special-file limits. Rollout preparation additionally invokes raw tar -xf, bypassing the verifier's safer path and link checks.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use one streaming bounded extractor for verification, smoke, and rollout preparation; allow regular files and directories only and enforce member and expanded-size limits.

blocking_findings.description: Persistence begins with descriptor-relative no-follow operations but later closes the root descriptor and writes metadata.json through a mutable pathname, allowing a symlink or root swap to redirect the final write.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Keep the trusted directory descriptor alive through metadata finalization and perform no-follow descriptor-relative atomic replacement.

blocking_findings.description: The packager writes or truncates the final archive pathname directly before writing its receipt. A failed run can replace a valid staged archive with partial bytes even though the retained publication itself used atomic renames.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Build and fsync the archive and receipt under temporary sibling names, validate them, then atomically replace final paths.

blocking_findings.description: The Unity serializer escapes selected characters but can emit other U+0000 through U+001F control characters literally, producing invalid JSON.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Escape every JSON control character and add exhaustive serializer tests for U+0000 through U+001F.

additional_findings.description: bird_launched records the rigid-body velocity before the actual launch velocity is computed and assigned.
Event and stability mutation paths do not consistently reject finalized recorders, while request 70 snapshots the recorder repeatedly.
Legacy request 38 record counts and request 62 payload lengths are peer-controlled 32-bit values without explicit protocol caps before looping or reading.
Packaging checks tracked git diffs but does not reject untracked Unity source/assets that can affect a build while provenance still claims the exact committed tree.
